diff --git a/backend/cmd/agentic-lens/capture_worker.go b/backend/cmd/agentic-lens/capture_worker.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a656dd7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/backend/cmd/agentic-lens/capture_worker.go
@@ -0,0 +1,288 @@
+package main
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"os/exec"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"time"
+
+	"agenticlens/internal/adapters/capture"
+	"agenticlens/internal/adapters/codex"
+	adaptersconfig "agenticlens/internal/adapters/config"
+	"agenticlens/internal/adapters/opencode"
+	"agenticlens/internal/domain"
+)
+
+func captureWorker(s *capture.Store, project, state string, policy domain.CaptureConfig) error {
+	lock, err := capture.AcquireWorker(state)
+	if err != nil || lock == nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	held := true
+	defer func() {
+		if held {
+			if e := lock.Close(); e != nil {
+				fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "worker unlock:", e)
+			}
+		}
+	}()
+	cfg, err := adaptersconfig.Load(project)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	binary, err := os.Executable()
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	started := time.Now()
+	var lastPass time.Time
+	var nextAttempt time.Time
+	var lastFailure string
+	successfulPass := false
+	backoff := time.Duration(policy.RefreshMS) * time.Millisecond
+	lastActivity := time.Now()
+	for time.Since(started) < time.Duration(policy.MaxLifetimeMS)*time.Millisecond {
+		enabled, e := automaticCaptureEnabled(project, state)
+		if e != nil || !enabled {
+			return e
+		}
+		req, err := s.PublicationRequest(context.Background())
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		now := time.Now()
+		if err := capture.WriteWorkerProgress(state, capture.WorkerProgress{PID: os.Getpid(), State: "running", Heartbeat: now.UnixMilli(), Deadline: started.Add(time.Duration(policy.MaxLifetimeMS) * time.Millisecond).UnixMilli(), NextAttempt: nextAttempt.UnixMilli(), Detail: lastFailure + fmt.Sprintf(" generation=%d acknowledged=%d pass_timeout_ms=%d max_sessions=%d max_source_bytes=%d", req.Generation, req.Acknowledged, policy.PassTimeoutMS, policy.MaxSessions, policy.MaxSourceBytes)}); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		rowsForActivity, activityErr := s.List(context.Background())
+		if activityErr != nil {
+			return activityErr
+		}
+		active := false
+		activityBudget := policy.MaxSourceBytes
+		for _, r := range rowsForActivity {
+			if r.TicketID != "" && r.Activity != "idle" && r.Event != "SessionEnd" && r.Event != "Stop" && r.Event != "session.idle" && r.Event != "session.error" {
+				if r.ParentID != "" && r.Identity.Source == domain.SourceOpenCode && r.ProjectDirectory == project && activityBudget >= 4*1024*1024 {
+					activityBudget -= 4 * 1024 * 1024
+					db, e := opencode.OpenDB(r.Identity.Store)
+					if e == nil {
+						ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
+						finished, proofErr := opencode.CaptureChildFinished(ctx, db.DB(), r.ParentID, r.Identity.SessionID)
+						cancel()
+						closeErr := db.Close()
+						if proofErr == nil && closeErr == nil && finished {
+							continue
+						}
+						if proofErr != nil || closeErr != nil {
+							lastFailure = fmt.Sprintf("child activity proof unavailable: %v", errors.Join(proofErr, closeErr))
+						}
+					} else {
+						lastFailure = fmt.Sprintf("child activity source unavailable: %v", e)
+					}
+				}
+				active = true
+			}
+		}
+		if !active && time.Since(lastActivity) >= time.Duration(policy.IdleMS)*time.Millisecond && now.UnixMilli()-req.RequestedAt >= int64(policy.IdleMS) && req.Generation == req.Acknowledged {
+			// Release before checking again: an event racing shutdown either starts a
+			// new owner or is seen here. Never consume a generation without a pass.
+			if err = lock.Close(); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			held = false
+			after, err := s.PublicationRequest(context.Background())
+			if err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			if after.Generation != after.Acknowledged {
+				enabled, e := automaticCaptureEnabled(project, state)
+				if e != nil || !enabled {
+					return e
+				}
+				return capture.LaunchWorker(binary, project, state)
+			}
+			return nil
+		}
+		due := req.Generation != req.Acknowledged || time.Since(lastPass) >= time.Duration(policy.RefreshMS)*time.Millisecond
+		if due && !now.Before(nextAttempt) && (time.Since(lastPass) >= time.Duration(policy.RefreshMS)*time.Millisecond || now.UnixMilli()-req.RequestedAt >= int64(policy.DebounceMS)) {
+			rows, err := s.List(context.Background())
+			if err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			tickets := map[string]bool{}
+			for _, r := range rows {
+				if r.TicketID != "" {
+					tickets[r.TicketID] = true
+				}
+			}
+			ordered := []string{}
+			for ticket := range tickets {
+				ordered = append(ordered, ticket)
+			}
+			sort.Strings(ordered)
+			ordered, err = s.PublicationTickets(context.Background(), ordered)
+			if err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			success := true
+			for _, ticket := range ordered {
+				enabled, e := automaticCaptureEnabled(project, state)
+				if e != nil || !enabled {
+					return e
+				}
+				dest := filepath.Join(project, cfg.Workspaces.Dir, ticket, "agentic_metrics.json")
+				if err = capture.ValidateDestination(project, dest); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				args := []string{"generate", "--ticket-id", ticket, "--json-output", dest, "--capture-dir", state, "--capture-auto"}
+				title, kind, metadataErr := domain.CaptureTicketMetadata(rows, ticket)
+				if metadataErr != nil {
+					success = false
+					lastFailure = metadataErr.Error()
+					fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "automatic publication pending:", metadataErr)
+					continue
+				}
+				if title != "" {
+					args = append(args, "--ticket-title", title)
+				}
+				if kind != "" {
+					args = append(args, "--ticket-type", kind)
+				}
+				if policy.Summary {
+					args = append(args, "--append", filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(dest), "SUMMARY.md"))
+				}
+				remaining := time.Duration(policy.MaxLifetimeMS)*time.Millisecond - time.Since(started)
+				if remaining <= 0 {
+					success = false
+					break
+				}
+				if err := s.AttemptPublicationTicket(context.Background(), ticket); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), min(remaining, time.Duration(policy.PassTimeoutMS)*time.Millisecond))
+				cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, binary, args...)
+				cmd.Dir = project
+				cmd.Stdout = os.Stdout
+				cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr
+				err = cmd.Run()
+				cancel()
+				if err != nil {
+					success = false
+					lastFailure = err.Error()
+					fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "automatic publication pending:", err)
+					if e := capture.WriteWorkerProgress(state, capture.WorkerProgress{PID: os.Getpid(), State: "failure", Heartbeat: time.Now().UnixMilli(), Deadline: started.Add(time.Duration(policy.MaxLifetimeMS) * time.Millisecond).UnixMilli(), NextAttempt: time.Now().Add(backoff * 2).UnixMilli(), Detail: err.Error()}); e != nil {
+						return e
+					}
+				}
+			}
+			if success {
+				successfulPass = true
+				lastFailure = ""
+				backoff = time.Duration(policy.RefreshMS) * time.Millisecond
+				if err = s.AcknowledgePublication(context.Background(), req.Generation); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+			afterRows, readErr := s.List(context.Background())
+			if readErr != nil {
+				return readErr
+			}
+			before := map[string]string{}
+			for _, r := range rows {
+				before[capture.IdentityKey(r.Identity)] = r.SourceFingerprint
+			}
+			for _, r := range afterRows {
+				if before[capture.IdentityKey(r.Identity)] != r.SourceFingerprint {
+					lastActivity = time.Now()
+				}
+			}
+			if !success {
+				backoff = min(backoff*2, time.Duration(policy.RefreshMS)*8*time.Millisecond)
+			}
+			nextAttempt = time.Now().Add(backoff)
+			lastPass = time.Now()
+		}
+		time.Sleep(time.Duration(policy.RefreshMS) * time.Millisecond)
+	}
+	// Failed publication cannot create an unbounded retry process chain. Durable
+	// pending work restarts on the next supported lifecycle/reconcile integration.
+	if !successfulPass || lastFailure != "" {
+		return fmt.Errorf("native worker lifetime exhausted; pending generation retained for next integration event: %s", lastFailure)
+	}
+	// A healthy finite owner transfers active work to another bounded native process.
+	if err = lock.Close(); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	held = false
+	enabled, e := automaticCaptureEnabled(project, state)
+	if e != nil || !enabled {
+		return e
+	}
+	return capture.LaunchWorker(binary, project, state)
+}
+
+func validateGenerationProject(project, state string, sessions []domain.SessionFact, ticket string) error {
+	if len(sessions) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	s, err := capture.OpenProject(state, project)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	defer s.Close()
+	rows, err := s.List(context.Background())
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	byID := map[string][]domain.CaptureRegistration{}
+	for _, r := range rows {
+		byID[r.Identity.SessionID] = append(byID[r.Identity.SessionID], r)
+	}
+	for _, owner := range sessions {
+		var candidates []domain.CaptureRegistration
+		for _, candidate := range byID[owner.ID] {
+			if owner.Source == "" || candidate.Identity.Source == owner.Source {
+				candidates = append(candidates, candidate)
+			}
+		}
+		if len(candidates) > 1 {
+			return fmt.Errorf("baseline owner %s has ambiguous source/store associations; explicit recovery required", owner.ID)
+		}
+		if len(candidates) == 0 {
+			return fmt.Errorf("baseline owner %s lacks verified project/source association; explicit recovery required", owner.ID)
+		}
+		r := candidates[0]
+		if r.TicketID != ticket {
+			return fmt.Errorf("baseline owner %s is bound to ticket %s, refusing %s", owner.ID, r.TicketID, ticket)
+		}
+		if r.Identity.Source == domain.SourceCodex && r.TranscriptPath != "" {
+			if err := codex.ValidateRolloutStore(r.Identity.Store, r.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+
+		if owner.Source != "" && r.Identity.Source != owner.Source {
+			return errors.New("baseline source conflicts with project registration")
+		}
+		if r.ProjectDirectory != project {
+			if err = capture.ValidateOwner(context.Background(), project, r); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("baseline owner %s project unresolved: %w", owner.ID, err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// Disabled policy stops new passes and handoffs. A publication already committing
+// may finish within PassTimeoutMS; disable never removes accepted facts.
+func automaticCaptureEnabled(project, state string) (bool, error) {
+	policy, err := adaptersconfig.ResolveCapture(project, "")
+	if err != nil || !policy.Enabled {
+		return false, err
+	}
+	return capture.AutomaticEnabled(state)
+}

+func TestCaptureNativeCrashReleasesOwnershipAndPreservesPendingGeneration(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Run("crash takeover", func(t *testing.T) { testNativePendingGeneration(t, true) })
+	t.Run("event during live pass", func(t *testing.T) { testNativePendingGeneration(t, false) })

+func testNativePendingGeneration(t *testing.T, crash bool) {
+	f := newCaptureGenerationFixture(t)
+	f.bind(t, f.write(t, 37))
+	local := []byte("telemetry:\n  capture:\n    refresh_ms: 100\n    debounce_ms: 0\n    idle_ms: 300\n    max_lifetime_ms: 10000\n")
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(f.project, ".agenticlens-config.local.yaml"), local, 0600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	store, err := capture.OpenProject(f.state, f.project)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer store.Close()
+	// Supply explicit metadata without invoking callbacks that launch detached owners.
+	id := domain.CaptureIdentity{Source: domain.SourceCodex, Store: f.store, SessionID: "root"}
+	if _, err = store.Change(context.Background(), id, func(r domain.CaptureRegistration) (domain.CaptureRegistration, error) {
+		r.TicketTitle = "Crash recovery"
+		r.TicketType = "feat"
+		r.Activity = "idle"
+		return r, nil
+	}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err = store.RequestPublication(context.Background()); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	output := filepath.Join(f.project, "records", "TEST-100", "agentic_metrics.json")
+	lock, err := capture.AcquirePublication(context.Background(), output)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	held := true
+	defer func() {
+		if held {
+			lock.Close()
+		}
+	}()
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 8*time.Second)
+	defer cancel()
+	worker := exec.CommandContext(ctx, cliBinaryPath, "capture", "worker", "--repo", f.project, "--state-dir", f.state)
+	worker.Dir = f.project
+	worker.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{Setsid: true}
+	// Files avoid unbounded inherited pipe waits if a killed worker leaves a generator.
+	log, err := os.CreateTemp(t.TempDir(), "worker-log")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer log.Close()
+	worker.Stdout = log
+	worker.Stderr = log
+	if err = worker.Start(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	reaped := false
+	defer func() {
+		if !reaped {
+			syscall.Kill(-worker.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL)
+			worker.Wait()
+		}
+	}()
+	deadline := time.Now().Add(3 * time.Second)
+	observed := false
+	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
+		owner, e := capture.AcquireWorker(f.state)
+		if e != nil {
+			t.Fatal(e)
+		}
+		if owner == nil {
+			observed = true
+			break
+		}
+		owner.Close()
+		time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
+	}
+	if !observed {
+		t.Fatal("native worker never acquired ownership")
+	}
+	// The worker publishes its captured generation before entering the pass. The
+	// output lock prevents acknowledgement while this observed generation is in flight.
+	observed = false
+	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
+		progress, e := capture.WorkerStatus(f.state)
+		if e != nil {
+			t.Fatal(e)
+		}
+		if progress.PID == worker.Process.Pid && strings.Contains(progress.Detail, "generation=1 acknowledged=0") {
+			observed = true
+			break
+		}
+		time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
+	}
+	if !observed {
+		t.Fatal("worker did not expose captured generation before blocked pass")
+	}
+	if crash {
+		if err = syscall.Kill(-worker.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		_ = worker.Wait()
+		reaped = true
+		req, err := store.PublicationRequest(context.Background())
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if req.Generation <= req.Acknowledged {
+			t.Fatalf("crashed pass swallowed request: %+v", req)
+		}
+		owner, err := capture.AcquireWorker(f.state)
+		if err != nil || owner == nil {
+			t.Fatalf("kernel ownership not released: %v", err)
+		}
+		owner.Close()
+
+	}
+	// Queue another generation during the interrupted pass; the replacement must
+	// publish both requests rather than acknowledge the old pass optimistically.
+	if err = store.RequestPublication(context.Background()); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err = lock.Close(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	held = false
+	if crash {
+		replacement := exec.CommandContext(ctx, cliBinaryPath, "capture", "worker", "--repo", f.project, "--state-dir", f.state)
+		replacement.Dir = f.project
+		if out, e := replacement.CombinedOutput(); e != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("takeover: %v %s", e, out)
+		}
+	} else {
+		if err = worker.Wait(); err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("live pass: %v: %s", err, readCaptureFile(t, log.Name()))
+		}
+		reaped = true
+	}
+	req, err := store.PublicationRequest(context.Background())
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if req.Generation != req.Acknowledged {
+		t.Fatalf("takeover left pending work: %+v", req)
+	}
+	var ledger domain.AgenticFactLedger
+	if err = json.Unmarshal(readCaptureFile(t, output), &ledger); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	assertCaptureRootInput(t, ledger, 37)
+}
+
+func TestCaptureLateTicketMustPublishBeforeIdle(t *testing.T) {

+package main_test
+
+import (
+	"agenticlens/internal/adapters/capture"
+	"agenticlens/internal/domain"
+	"context"
+	"database/sql"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"os"
+	"os/exec"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+// setOpenCodeFixtureProject writes the supported native session directory column;
+// a command flag alone must never count as source ownership evidence.
+func setOpenCodeFixtureProject(t *testing.T, path, project string) {
+	t.Helper()
+	db, err := sql.Open("sqlite", path)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer db.Close()
+	var count int
+	if err = db.QueryRow(`SELECT count(*) FROM pragma_table_info('session') WHERE name='directory'`).Scan(&count); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if count == 0 {
+		if _, err = db.Exec(`ALTER TABLE session ADD COLUMN directory TEXT`); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	if _, err = db.Exec(`UPDATE session SET directory=?`, project); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+}
+func setOpenCodeFixtureProjectIfSelected(t *testing.T, cmd *exec.Cmd, project string) {
+	t.Helper()
+	for i, arg := range cmd.Args {
+		if arg == "--db-path" && i+1 < len(cmd.Args) {
+			path := cmd.Args[i+1]
+			if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
+				setOpenCodeFixtureProject(t, path, project)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+// prepareLegacyGenerateFixture gives older CLI tests their own configured project.
+// Tests with explicit project/configuration retain that configuration unchanged.
+func prepareLegacyGenerateFixture(t *testing.T, cmd *exec.Cmd) {
+	t.Helper()
+	if cmd.Dir == "" {
+		for i, arg := range cmd.Args {
+			if (arg == "--json-output" || arg == "--append") && i+1 < len(cmd.Args) {
+				cmd.Dir = filepath.Dir(cmd.Args[i+1])
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if cmd.Dir == "" {
+			cmd.Dir = t.TempDir()
+		}
+		if err := os.MkdirAll(cmd.Dir, 0700); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		config := filepath.Join(cmd.Dir, ".agenticlens-config.yaml")
+		if _, err := os.Stat(config); os.IsNotExist(err) {
+			data := "project_name: CLIFixture\nworkspaces:\n  dir: records\nticket:\n  prefixes:\n    - prefix: AL\n    - prefix: GEN\n      ticket_type: chore\n    - prefix: PO\n      ticket_type: docs\n    - prefix: FIX\n      ticket_type: fix\nrole_mappings:\n  build: orchestrator\ncode_metrics:\n  source_roots: [src]\nanomaly_thresholds:\n  context_ceiling_warning_tokens: 160000\n  context_ceiling_critical_tokens: 200000\n"
+			if err := os.WriteFile(config, []byte(data), 0600); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	setOpenCodeFixtureProjectIfSelected(t, cmd, cmd.Dir)
+	for i, arg := range cmd.Args {
+		if arg == "--json-output" && i+1 < len(cmd.Args) {
+			body, err := os.ReadFile(cmd.Args[i+1])
+			if err != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			var ledger domain.AgenticFactLedger
+			if json.Unmarshal(body, &ledger) == nil && len(ledger.Sessions) > 0 {
+				scoped, err := capture.ProjectState(filepath.Join(cmd.Dir, ".agenticlens-capture"), cmd.Dir)
+				if err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+				registry, err := capture.OpenProject(scoped, cmd.Dir)
+				if err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+				rows, err := registry.List(context.Background())
+				registry.Close()
+				if err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+				if len(rows) == 0 {
+					acceptFixtureOwners(t, cmd.Dir, scoped, *ledger.TicketID, ledger.Sessions)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+// acceptFixtureOwners creates native ownership evidence for previously accepted
+// snapshots, then removes the enrichment source. This retains the original
+// unavailable-source preservation oracle without trusting a copied ledger.
+func acceptFixtureOwners(t *testing.T, project, state, ticket string, sessions []domain.SessionFact) {
+	t.Helper()
+	scoped, err := capture.ProjectState(state, project)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	registry, err := capture.OpenProject(scoped, project)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer registry.Close()
+	dbPath := setupIsolatedEmptyDB(t)
+	db, err := sql.Open("sqlite", dbPath)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for _, owner := range sessions {
+		if owner.Source != domain.SourceOpenCode {
+			continue
+		}
+		if _, err = db.Exec(`INSERT INTO session(id) VALUES(?)`, owner.ID); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	if err = db.Close(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	setOpenCodeFixtureProject(t, dbPath, project)
+	for _, owner := range sessions {
+		if owner.Source != domain.SourceOpenCode {
+			continue
+		}
+		id := domain.CaptureIdentity{Source: owner.Source, Store: dbPath, SessionID: owner.ID}
+		r, err := registry.Register(context.Background(), id, "", "fixture accepted ownership")
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if err = capture.ValidateOwner(context.Background(), project, r); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if _, err = registry.Bind(context.Background(), id, ticket, r.Request); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if _, err = registry.Change(context.Background(), id, func(r domain.CaptureRegistration) (domain.CaptureRegistration, error) {
+			r.ProjectDirectory = project
+			return r, nil
+		}); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	if err = os.Remove(dbPath); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,157 @@
+package capture
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"regexp"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+// InstalledStates discovers owned installation state from stable project files.
+// Legacy hook/plugin content is read as data, never executed or broadly imported.
+func InstalledStates(project string) ([]string, error) {
+	states := []string{}
+	for _, source := range []string{"codex", "opencode"} {
+		anchor := filepath.Join(project, "."+source, "agenticlens-installation.json")
+		body, err := os.ReadFile(anchor)
+		state := ""
+		if err == nil {
+			var m Manifest
+			if err = json.Unmarshal(body, &m); err != nil {
+				return nil, err
+			}
+			owner, e := ProjectDirectory(m.Repository)
+			if e != nil || owner != project || m.Protocol != ProtocolVersion {
+				return nil, errors.New("installation discovery ownership conflict")
+			}
+			state = m.StateDir
+		} else if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if state == "" {
+			path := filepath.Join(project, ".codex", "hooks.json")
+			pattern := `--state-dir\s+'([^']*)'`
+			if source == "opencode" {
+				path = filepath.Join(project, ".opencode", "plugins", "agenticlens-capture.ts")
+				pattern = `const stateDir = ("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")`
+			}
+			body, err = os.ReadFile(path)
+			if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				return nil, err
+			}
+			if source == "codex" {
+				var config struct {
+					Hooks map[string][]struct {
+						Hooks []struct {
+							Command string `json:"command"`
+							Status  string `json:"statusMessage"`
+						} `json:"hooks"`
+					} `json:"hooks"`
+				}
+				if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &config); err != nil {
+					return nil, err
+				}
+				for _, groups := range config.Hooks {
+					for _, group := range groups {
+						for _, h := range group.Hooks {
+							if h.Status != marker {
+								continue
+							}
+							if candidate, ok := installedStateArgument(h.Command); ok {
+								state = candidate
+							}
+						}
+					}
+				}
+			} else if match := regexp.MustCompile(pattern).FindSubmatch(body); len(match) > 1 {
+				if err := json.Unmarshal(match[1], &state); err != nil {
+					return nil, err
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if state == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		m, err := ReadManifest(state, source)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("installed %s state %s unavailable: %w; restore its manifest before reinstall", source, state, err)
+		}
+		owner, err := ProjectDirectory(m.Repository)
+		if err != nil || owner != project {
+			return nil, errors.New("installed state belongs to another project")
+		}
+		states = append(states, state)
+	}
+	return states, nil
+}
+
+// CheckInstalledState diagnoses frozen installed paths without overriding an
+// intentional CLI state selection or copying registrations between namespaces.
+func CheckInstalledState(project, state string, explicit bool) error {
+	states, err := InstalledStates(project)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	for _, installed := range states {
+		canonical, err := ProjectDirectory(installed)
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		expected, err := ProjectDirectory(state)
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if canonical != expected {
+			detail := fmt.Sprintf("installed capture state %s differs from configured/selected state %s; restore telemetry.capture.state_dir to the installed base or use --state-dir %s for status/recovery and owned reinstall/removal; preserve the old registry", installed, state, installed)
+			if !explicit {
+				return errors.New(detail)
+			}
+			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Capture state drift (explicit CLI override retained):", detail)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// Installed commands contain only statically quoted arguments generated by Install.
+// Decode concatenated shell quotes as data, including literal apostrophes.
+func installedStateArgument(command string) (string, bool) {
+	rest := ""
+	for _, flag := range []string{"'--state-dir' ", "\"--state-dir\" ", "--state-dir "} {
+		start := strings.Index(command, flag)
+		if start >= 0 {
+			rest = command[start+len(flag):]
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	if rest == "" {
+		return "", false
+	}
+
+	var result strings.Builder
+	quote := byte(0)
+	for i := 0; i < len(rest); i++ {
+		c := rest[i]
+		if quote == 0 {
+			if c == ' ' {
+				break
+			}
+			if c == '\'' || c == '"' {
+				quote = c
+				continue
+			}
+			return "", false
+		}
+		if c == quote {
+			quote = 0
+			continue
+		}
+		result.WriteByte(c)
+	}
+	return result.String(), quote == 0 && result.Len() > 0
+}

index 0000000..1d1bb39
--- /dev/null
+++ b/backend/internal/adapters/capture/project.go
@@ -0,0 +1,225 @@
+package capture
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+
+	"agenticlens/internal/adapters/codex"
+	"agenticlens/internal/adapters/opencode"
+	"agenticlens/internal/domain"
+)
+
+// ProjectDirectory resolves physical paths through existing ancestors and dangling
+// symlinks before a destination or its parent exists. Source ownership still
+// requires independent evidence from an existing source directory.
+func ProjectDirectory(path string) (string, error) {
+	separator := string(filepath.Separator)
+	target := filepath.FromSlash(path)
+	if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
+		if filepath.VolumeName(target) != "" {
+			return "", errors.New("drive-relative path requires an absolute destination")
+		}
+		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", err
+		}
+		if target != "" && os.IsPathSeparator(target[0]) {
+			target = filepath.VolumeName(cwd) + target
+		} else {
+			// Join/Abs would clean .. before an earlier symlink is followed.
+			target = cwd + separator + target
+		}
+	}
+	volume := filepath.VolumeName(target)
+	current := volume + separator
+	pending := strings.Split(target[len(volume):], separator)
+	links := 0
+	for len(pending) > 0 {
+		part := pending[0]
+		pending = pending[1:]
+		switch part {
+		case "", ".":
+			continue
+		case "..":
+			current = filepath.Dir(current)
+			continue
+		}
+		next := filepath.Join(current, part)
+		info, err := os.Lstat(next)
+		if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
+			current = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", err
+		}
+		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink == 0 {
+			current = next
+			continue
+		}
+		links++
+		if links > 255 {
+			return "", errors.New("path has excessive symlink traversal")
+		}
+		link, err := os.Readlink(next)
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", err
+		}
+		link = filepath.FromSlash(link)
+		if filepath.IsAbs(link) {
+			volume = filepath.VolumeName(link)
+			current = volume + separator
+			link = link[len(volume):]
+		} else if filepath.VolumeName(link) != "" {
+			return "", errors.New("drive-relative symlink requires an absolute destination")
+		} else if link != "" && os.IsPathSeparator(link[0]) {
+			current = filepath.VolumeName(current) + separator
+		}
+		// Process the target before the remaining suffix. In particular, a
+		// symlink within the target must be followed before a subsequent .. .
+		pending = append(strings.Split(link, separator), pending...)
+	}
+	return current, nil
+}
+
+// ProjectState isolates external and project-local state by exact physical directory.
+// Legacy unscoped registries remain untouched for explicit recovery.
+func ProjectState(base, project string) (string, error) {
+	project, err := ProjectDirectory(project)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	base, err = ProjectDirectory(base)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(project))
+	key := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
+	if filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(base)) == "projects" {
+		if filepath.Base(base) != key {
+			return "", errors.New("state namespace belongs to another project")
+		}
+		return base, nil
+	}
+	return filepath.Join(base, "projects", key), nil
+}
+func OpenProject(directory, project string) (*Store, error) {
+	project, err := ProjectDirectory(project)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	s, err := Open(directory)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	if _, err = s.db.Exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_owner (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), directory TEXT NOT NULL); INSERT OR IGNORE INTO project_owner VALUES(1,?)`, project); err != nil {
+		return nil, errors.Join(err, s.Close())
+	}
+	var owner string
+	if err = s.db.QueryRow(`SELECT directory FROM project_owner WHERE singleton=1`).Scan(&owner); err != nil {
+		return nil, errors.Join(err, s.Close())
+	}
+	if owner != project {
+		return nil, errors.Join(errors.New("copied capture state belongs to another project; explicit recovery required"), s.Close())
+	}
+	s.project = project
+	return s, nil
+}
+
+// ValidateProject accepts contained source directories unless a nearer project owns them.
+// Caller flags and registry location
+// cannot grant a session membership in a different project.
+func ValidateProject(project, sourceDirectory string) error {
+	if sourceDirectory == "" || !filepath.IsAbs(sourceDirectory) {
+		return errors.New("source project directory unavailable; ownership unresolved")
+	}
+	expected, err := ProjectDirectory(project)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	actual, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(sourceDirectory)
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("source project unavailable: %w", err)
+	}
+	rel, err := filepath.Rel(expected, actual)
+	if err != nil || rel == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
+		return errors.New("source project directory conflicts with configured project")
+	}
+	for dir := actual; dir != expected; dir = filepath.Dir(dir) {
+		for _, marker := range []string{".agenticlens-config.yaml", ".agenticlens-config.yml", ".agenticlens-config.json", ".git"} {
+			if _, e := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(dir, marker)); e == nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("source belongs to nearer project %s; explicit project resolution required", dir)
+			} else if !errors.Is(e, os.ErrNotExist) {
+				return e
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func ValidateOwner(ctx context.Context, project string, r domain.CaptureRegistration) error {
+	if r.Identity.Source == domain.SourceCodex {
+		path := r.TranscriptPath
+		if path == "" {
+			var err error
+			path, err = codex.DiscoverExactRolloutPath(r.Identity.Store, r.Identity.SessionID)
+			if err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+		if err := codex.ValidateRolloutStore(r.Identity.Store, path); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		b := &workBudget{sessions: 1, bytes: MaxPayloadBytes}
+		t, err := readMetadata(ctx, path, b)
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if t.ThreadID != r.Identity.SessionID {
+			return errors.New("source identity mismatch")
+		}
+		return ValidateProject(project, t.WorkingDir)
+	}
+	db, err := opencode.OpenDB(r.Identity.Store)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	defer db.Close()
+	directory, err := opencode.CaptureProjectDirectory(ctx, db.DB(), r.Identity.SessionID)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	return ValidateProject(project, directory)
+}
+func (s *Store) validateOwner(ctx context.Context, r domain.CaptureRegistration) error {
+	if s.project == "" {
+		return nil
+	}
+	return ValidateOwner(ctx, s.project, r)
+}
+
+// ValidateDestination forbids publication outside the configured project, including
+// nested symlink escapes. It does not create any destination directories.
+func ValidateDestination(project, path string) error {
+	project, err := ProjectDirectory(project)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	target, err := ProjectDirectory(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	rel, err := filepath.Rel(project, target)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if rel == ".." || (len(rel) > 3 && rel[:3] == ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
+		return errors.New("publication destination escapes project directory")
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+package capture_test
+
+import (

+
+func TestProjectStateAliasesIsolationAndCopiedOwnership(t *testing.T) {
+	a, b, base := t.TempDir(), t.TempDir(), t.TempDir()
+	one, err := capture.ProjectState(base, a)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	two, err := capture.ProjectState(base, b)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if one == two {
+		t.Fatal("distinct project directories collapsed")
+	}
+	alias := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "alias")
+	if err = os.Symlink(a, alias); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	same, err := capture.ProjectState(base, alias)
+	if err != nil || same != one {
+		t.Fatalf("alias split: %s %v", same, err)
+	}
+	s, err := capture.OpenProject(one, a)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err = s.Close(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if wrong, err := capture.OpenProject(one, b); err == nil {
+		wrong.Close()
+		t.Fatal("copied state reassigned")
+	}
+	if err = capture.ValidateProject(a, b); err == nil {
+		t.Fatal("caller project overrode source project")
+	}
+	if err = capture.ValidateDestination(a, filepath.Join(a, "..", filepath.Base(a)+"-other", "ledger")); err == nil {
+		t.Fatal("string prefix authorized destination")
+	}
+	if err = capture.ValidateDestination(a, filepath.Join(alias, "nested", "ledger")); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	escape := filepath.Join(a, "escape")
+	if err = os.Symlink(b, escape); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err = capture.ValidateDestination(a, filepath.Join(escape, "new", "ledger")); err == nil {
+		t.Fatal("nested symlink escaped")
+	}
+}
+
+func TestProjectDestinationResolvesDanglingSymlinks(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, outside := range []bool{false, true} {
+		for _, ancestor := range []bool{false, true} {
+			t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("outside=%t/ancestor=%t", outside, ancestor), func(t *testing.T) {
+				project := t.TempDir()
+				base := project
+				if outside {
+					base = t.TempDir()
+				}
+				target := filepath.Join(base, "absent")
+				link := filepath.Join(project, "link")
+				// A relative target must be resolved from the link's directory.
+				relative, err := filepath.Rel(project, target)
+				if err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+				if err = os.Symlink(relative, link); err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+				path := link
+				if ancestor {
+					path = filepath.Join(link, "nested", "ledger.json")
+					target = filepath.Join(target, "nested", "ledger.json")
+				}
+				resolved, err := capture.ProjectDirectory(path)
+				if err != nil || resolved != target {
+					t.Fatalf("physical destination: %s %v; want %s", resolved, err, target)
+				}
+				if err = capture.ValidateDestination(project, path); (err != nil) != outside {
+					t.Fatalf("containment outside=%t: %v", outside, err)
+				}
+			})
+		}
+	}
+	project := t.TempDir()
+	loop := filepath.Join(project, "loop")
+	if err := os.Symlink("loop", loop); err != nil {

+func TestProjectDirectoryTraversesSymlinksBeforeDotDot(t *testing.T) {
+	project, outside := t.TempDir(), t.TempDir()
+	child := filepath.Join(outside, "child")

+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for _, existing := range []bool{false, true} {
+		t.Run(fmt.Sprint(existing), func(t *testing.T) {
+			victim := filepath.Join(outside, "summary")
+			if existing {
+				if err := os.WriteFile(victim, []byte("sentinel"), 0600); err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+			}
+			alias := filepath.Join(project, "alias-"+fmt.Sprint(existing))
+			if err := os.Symlink("hop/../summary", alias); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			for _, path := range []string{alias, project + "/hop/../summary"} {
+				resolved, err := capture.ProjectDirectory(path)
+				if err != nil || resolved != victim {
+					t.Fatalf("physical traversal: %s %v; want %s", resolved, err, victim)
+				}
+				if existing {
+					native, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path)
+					if err != nil || native != resolved {

+func TestPublicationLockSharesPhysicalAliasBeforeAndAfterCreation(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, directoryAlias := range []bool{false, true} {
+		for _, state := range []string{"missing", "existing", "created-during-lock"} {
+			t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("directory=%t/%s", directoryAlias, state), func(t *testing.T) {
+				t.Setenv("XDG_CACHE_HOME", t.TempDir())
+				project := t.TempDir()
+				target := filepath.Join(project, "ledger.json")
+				alias := filepath.Join(project, "alias.json")
+				linkTarget := target
+				if directoryAlias {
+					alias = filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "project")
+					linkTarget = project
+				}
+				if err := os.Symlink(linkTarget, alias); err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+				if directoryAlias {
+					alias = filepath.Join(alias, "ledger.json")
+				}
+				if state == "existing" {
+					if err := os.WriteFile(target, []byte("before"), 0600); err != nil {
+						t.Fatal(err)
+					}
+				}
+				first, err := capture.AcquirePublication(context.Background(), alias)
+				if err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+				defer func() {
+					if first != nil {
+						first.Close()
+					}
+				}()
+				if state == "created-during-lock" {
+					if err := os.WriteFile(target, []byte("during"), 0600); err != nil {
+						t.Fatal(err)
+					}
+				}
+				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 100*time.Millisecond)
+				defer cancel()
+				second, err := capture.AcquirePublication(ctx, target)
+				if err == nil {
+					second.Close()
+					t.Fatal("same physical ledger has simultaneous publication owners")
+				}
+				if !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
+					t.Fatalf("unexpected contention error: %v", err)
+				}
+				if err := first.Close(); err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+				first = nil
+				second, err = capture.AcquirePublication(context.Background(), target)
+				if err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+				if err := second.Close(); err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+			})
+		}
+	}
+}

+func TestPublicationGenerationAcknowledgesOnlyObservedWork(t *testing.T) {

+	ctx := context.Background()
+	if err := s.RequestPublication(ctx); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	first, err := s.PublicationRequest(ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err = s.RequestPublication(ctx); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err = s.AcknowledgePublication(ctx, first.Generation); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	next, err := s.PublicationRequest(ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if next.Generation == next.Acknowledged || next.Acknowledged != first.Generation {
+		t.Fatalf("unseen event consumed: %+v", next)
+	}

+	base, a, b := t.TempDir(), t.TempDir(), t.TempDir()
+	one, _ := capture.ProjectState(base, a)
+	two, _ := capture.ProjectState(base, b)
+	sa, err := capture.OpenProject(one, a)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer sa.Close()
+	sb, err := capture.OpenProject(two, b)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer sb.Close()
+	id := domain.CaptureIdentity{Source: domain.SourceCodex, Store: t.TempDir(), SessionID: "root"}
+	row, err := sa.Register(ctx, id, "", "SessionStart")

+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if _, err = sa.Bind(ctx, id, "AL-68", row.Request); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if rows, err := sb.List(ctx); err != nil || len(rows) != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("cross-project registrations: %+v %v", rows, err)
+	}
+}

+// sourceFingerprint is an invalidation hint, never an ownership proof. Failed
+// probes force extraction. Successful unchanged probes reuse accepted facts.
+func sourceFingerprint(ctx context.Context, r domain.CaptureRegistration) (string, error) {
+	if r.Identity.Source == domain.SourceCodex {

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f6a7bc3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/backend/internal/adapters/capture/worker.go
@@ -0,0 +1,188 @@
+package capture
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"database/sql"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"os/exec"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"time"
+)
+
+// RequestPublication commits a generation before native worker launch. A worker
+// acknowledges only the generation captured before its source/publication pass.
+func (s *Store) RequestPublication(ctx context.Context) error {
+	_, err := s.db.ExecContext(ctx, `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS publication_request (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), generation INTEGER NOT NULL, acknowledged INTEGER NOT NULL, requested_at INTEGER NOT NULL); INSERT INTO publication_request VALUES(1,1,0,?) ON CONFLICT(singleton) DO UPDATE SET generation=generation+1,requested_at=excluded.requested_at`, time.Now().UnixMilli())
+	return err
+}
+
+type PublicationRequest struct {
+	Generation   int64
+	Acknowledged int64
+	RequestedAt  int64
+}
+
+func (s *Store) PublicationRequest(ctx context.Context) (PublicationRequest, error) {
+	var r PublicationRequest
+	var exists int
+	if err := s.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='publication_request'`).Scan(&exists); err != nil {
+		return r, err
+	}
+	if exists == 0 {
+		return r, nil
+	}
+	err := s.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT generation,acknowledged,requested_at FROM publication_request WHERE singleton=1`).Scan(&r.Generation, &r.Acknowledged, &r.RequestedAt)
+	if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
+		return r, nil
+	}
+	return r, err
+}
+func (s *Store) AcknowledgePublication(ctx context.Context, generation int64) error {
+	_, err := s.db.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE publication_request SET acknowledged=? WHERE singleton=1 AND acknowledged<?`, generation, generation)
+	return err
+}
+
+// AcquireWorker never queues a second worker. Kernel ownership releases on crash.
+func AcquireWorker(directory string) (*PublicationLock, error) {
+	file, err := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(directory, "worker.lock"), os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0600)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	held, err := tryPublicationLock(file)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, errors.Join(err, file.Close())
+	}
+	if !held {
+		return nil, file.Close()
+	}
+	return &PublicationLock{file}, nil
+}
+
+// LaunchWorker disconnects callback pipes and process group. It never invokes a
+// wrapper, model, shell, network client or separately installed service.
+func LaunchWorker(binary, project, state string) error {
+	cmd := exec.Command(binary, "capture", "worker", "--repo", project, "--state-dir", state)
+	cmd.Dir = project
+	configureWorkerProcess(cmd)
+	logPath := filepath.Join(state, "worker.log")
+	flags := os.O_CREATE | os.O_WRONLY | os.O_APPEND
+	if info, e := os.Stat(logPath); e == nil && info.Size() > 1024*1024 {
+		flags = os.O_CREATE | os.O_WRONLY | os.O_TRUNC
+	}
+	log, err := os.OpenFile(logPath, flags, 0600)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	cmd.Stdout = log
+	cmd.Stderr = log
+	if err = cmd.Start(); err != nil {
+		return errors.Join(err, log.Close())
+	}
+	// Wait reaps children when the host lives longer than a callback.
+	go func() {
+		if err := cmd.Wait(); err != nil {
+			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "native capture worker:", err)
+		}
+	}()
+	return log.Close()
+}
+
+// WorkerProgress is local operational evidence, never source telemetry.
+type WorkerProgress struct {
+	PID         int    `json:"pid"`
+	State       string `json:"state"`
+	Heartbeat   int64  `json:"heartbeat"`
+	Deadline    int64  `json:"deadline"`
+	NextAttempt int64  `json:"next_attempt"`
+	Detail      string `json:"detail"`
+}
+
+func WriteWorkerProgress(directory string, progress WorkerProgress) error {
+	body, err := json.Marshal(progress)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	f, err := os.CreateTemp(directory, ".worker-status-")
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	name := f.Name()
+	defer func() {
+		if e := os.Remove(name); e != nil && !errors.Is(e, os.ErrNotExist) {
+			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "worker status cleanup:", e)
+		}
+	}()
+	_, err = f.Write(body)
+	if e := errors.Join(err, f.Close()); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return os.Rename(name, filepath.Join(directory, "worker-status.json"))
+}
+func WorkerStatus(directory string) (WorkerProgress, error) {
+	var p WorkerProgress
+	body, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(directory, "worker-status.json"))
+	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
+		return p, err
+	}
+	if len(body) > 0 {
+		if err = json.Unmarshal(body, &p); err != nil {
+			return p, err
+		}
+	}
+	lock, err := AcquireWorker(directory)
+	if err != nil {
+		return p, err
+	}
+	if lock != nil {
+		p.State = "stopped"
+		return p, lock.Close()
+	}
+	p.State = "running"
+	return p, nil
+}
+
+// AutomaticEnabled preserves compatibility with registries created before install
+// manifests existed. Once installed, at least one owned integration must be active.
+func AutomaticEnabled(directory string) (bool, error) {
+	found := false
+	for _, source := range []string{"codex", "opencode"} {
+		m, err := ReadManifest(directory, source)
+		if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
+			continue
+		}
+		if err != nil {
+			return false, err
+		}
+		found = true
+		if m.Active {
+			return true, nil
+		}
+	}
+	return !found, nil
+}
+
+// PublicationTickets rotates the ticket pass across bounded worker lifetimes.
+// Persisting the attempted ticket prevents an expensive early ticket from
+// consuming every lifetime before another ticket receives an attempt.
+func (s *Store) PublicationTickets(ctx context.Context, tickets []string) ([]string, error) {
+	if _, err := s.db.ExecContext(ctx, `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS publication_cursor(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), ticket TEXT NOT NULL)`); err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	var cursor string
+	err := s.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT ticket FROM publication_cursor WHERE singleton=1`).Scan(&cursor)
+	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	split := 0
+	for split < len(tickets) && tickets[split] <= cursor {
+		split++
+	}
+	return append(append([]string{}, tickets[split:]...), tickets[:split]...), nil
+}
+func (s *Store) AttemptPublicationTicket(ctx context.Context, ticket string) error {
+	_, err := s.db.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO publication_cursor VALUES(1,?) ON CONFLICT(singleton) DO UPDATE SET ticket=excluded.ticket`, ticket)
+	return err
+}

+// DiscoverExactRolloutPath selects one owner rather than its complete native
+// family. Family discovery remains separate so children validate their own cwd.
+func DiscoverExactRolloutPath(home, sessionID string) (string, error) {
+	paths, err := listRolloutPaths(home)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	selected := ""
+	for _, path := range paths {
+		candidate, e := inspectRollout(path, "")
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		if candidate.threadID != sessionID {
+			continue
+		}
+		if selected != "" {
+			return "", fmt.Errorf("exact Codex owner %s has ambiguous rollout paths", sessionID)
+		}
+		selected = path
+	}
+	if selected == "" {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("exact Codex owner %s unavailable", sessionID)
+	}
+	return selected, nil
+}
+
+// ValidateRolloutStore proves physical membership in the selected live or archive
+// store without rescanning every transcript for each callback. Session identity
+// is validated separately from the authoritative metadata by the caller.
+func ValidateRolloutStore(home, path string) error {
+	actual, err := physicalRolloutPath(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	for _, name := range []string{"sessions", "archived_sessions"} {
+		root, err := physicalRolloutPath(filepath.Join(home, name))
+		if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
+			continue
+		}
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		rel, err := filepath.Rel(root, actual)
+		if err == nil && rel != "." && rel != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) && !filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
+			return nil
+		}
+	}
+	return fmt.Errorf("Codex transcript does not belong to selected source store %s", home)
+}
+
+func physicalRolloutPath(path string) (string, error) {
+	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	real, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absolute)
+	if err == nil {
+		return real, nil
+	}
+	if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	parent := filepath.Dir(absolute)
+	if parent == absolute {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	real, err = physicalRolloutPath(parent)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	return filepath.Join(real, filepath.Base(absolute)), nil
+}

+package config
+
+import (
+	"agenticlens/internal/domain"
+	"bytes"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+)
+
+// ResolveCapture overlays defaults, portable YAML and machine-local YAML in that
+// order. Relative state paths always belong to the explicitly selected project.
+func ResolveCapture(project, stateOverride string) (domain.CaptureConfig, error) {
+	cfg := domain.DefaultCaptureConfig()
+	root, err := ProjectRoot(project)
+	if err != nil {
+		return cfg, err
+	}
+	project = root
+	shared, err := FindConfigFile(project)
+	if err != nil {
+		return cfg, err
+	}
+	for _, name := range []string{shared, filepath.Join(project, ".agenticlens-config.local.yaml")} {
+		if name == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		data, err := os.ReadFile(name)
+		if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
+			continue
+		}
+		if err != nil {
+			return cfg, err
+		}
+		cfg, err = decodeCapturePolicy(data, cfg)
+		if err != nil {
+			return cfg, fmt.Errorf("capture configuration %s: %w", name, err)
+		}
+	}
+	if stateOverride != "" {
+		cfg.StateDir = stateOverride
+	}
+	if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
+		return cfg, err
+	}
+
+	cfg.StateDir = ExpandHomePath(cfg.StateDir)
+	if !filepath.IsAbs(cfg.StateDir) {
+		cfg.StateDir = filepath.Join(project, cfg.StateDir)
+	}
+	return cfg, nil
+}
+
+func decodeCapturePolicy(data []byte, previous domain.CaptureConfig) (domain.CaptureConfig, error) {
+	overlay := struct {
+		Telemetry struct {
+			Capture domain.CaptureConfig `yaml:"capture"`
+		} `yaml:"telemetry"`
+	}{}
+	overlay.Telemetry.Capture = previous
+	var err error
+	if bytes.HasPrefix(bytes.TrimSpace(data), []byte("{")) {
+		err = json.Unmarshal(data, &overlay)
+	} else {
+		err = yaml.Unmarshal(data, &overlay)
+	}
+	return overlay.Telemetry.Capture, err
+}

+		t.Fatal("invalid work bound accepted")

+}
+
+func TestCaptureOwningProjectFormatsAndNestedBoundary(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, ext := range []string{"yaml", "yml", "json"} {
+		t.Run(ext, func(t *testing.T) {
+			project := t.TempDir()
+			child := filepath.Join(project, "src")
+			if err := os.Mkdir(child, 0700); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			body := "telemetry:\n  capture:\n    state_dir: configured\n    enabled: false\n"
+			if ext == "json" {
+				body = `{"telemetry":{"capture":{"state_dir":"configured","enabled":false}}}`
+			}
+			if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(project, ".agenticlens-config."+ext), []byte(body), 0600); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			cfg, err := ResolveCapture(child, "")
+			if err != nil || cfg.StateDir != filepath.Join(project, "configured") || cfg.Enabled {

+			if err := os.Mkdir(filepath.Join(child, ".git"), 0700); err != nil {

+			root, err := ProjectRoot(child)

+	}

+package opencode

+import (
+	"context"

+
+func TestCaptureChildFinishedRequiresNativeParentAndCompletedTask(t *testing.T) {
+	db, err := sql.Open("sqlite", filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "source.db"))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer func() {
+		if err := db.Close(); err != nil {
+			t.Error(err)
+		}
+	}()
+	_, err = db.Exec(`CREATE TABLE session(id TEXT,parent_id TEXT); CREATE TABLE part(session_id TEXT,time_updated INTEGER,data TEXT); INSERT INTO session VALUES('child','parent'); INSERT INTO part VALUES('parent',1,'{"type":"tool","tool":"task","state":{"status":"running","metadata":{"sessionId":"child"}}}')`)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if finished, err := CaptureChildFinished(context.Background(), db, "parent", "child"); err != nil || finished {
+		t.Fatalf("running %v %v", finished, err)
+	}
+	if _, err = db.Exec(`UPDATE part SET data=replace(data,'running','completed')`); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if finished, err := CaptureChildFinished(context.Background(), db, "parent", "child"); err != nil || !finished {
+		t.Fatalf("completed %v %v", finished, err)
+	}
+	if finished, err := CaptureChildFinished(context.Background(), db, "wrong", "child"); err != nil || finished {
+		t.Fatalf("wrong parent %v %v", finished, err)
+	}
+	if _, err = db.Exec(`INSERT INTO part SELECT session_id,2,replace(data,'completed','running') FROM part`); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if finished, err := CaptureChildFinished(context.Background(), db, "parent", "child"); err != nil || finished {
+		t.Fatalf("resumed task %v %v", finished, err)
+	}
+
+}

+
+// CaptureProjectDirectory reads authoritative per-session directory metadata.
+// Older layouts without it remain unresolved rather than borrowing caller cwd.
+func CaptureProjectDirectory(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, id string) (string, error) {
+	family, err := captureSchemaFamily(ctx, db, id)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	table := "session"
+	if family == schemaFamilyV2 {
+		table = "session_v2"
+	}
+	columns, err := tableColumns(db)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	if !columns[table]["directory"] {
+		return "", errors.New("source schema has no authoritative session directory")
+	}
+	var directory string
+	err = db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT directory FROM `+table+` WHERE id=?`, id).Scan(&directory)
+	return directory, err
+}
+
+// CaptureSourceFingerprint probes cumulative source revision without decoding bodies.
+func CaptureSourceFingerprint(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, id string) (string, error) {
+	family, err := captureSchemaFamily(ctx, db, id)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	table := "session"
+	if family == schemaFamilyV2 {
+		table = "session_v2"
+	}
+	var updated int64
+	if err = db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT time_updated FROM `+table+` WHERE id=?`, id).Scan(&updated); err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	result := fmt.Sprint(updated)
+	tables := []string{"message", "part"}
+	if family == schemaFamilyV2 {
+		tables = []string{"session_message"}
+	}
+	for _, table := range tables {
+		var count, size, stamp int64
+		if err = db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT count(*),coalesce(sum(length(data)),0),coalesce(max(time_updated),0) FROM `+table+` WHERE session_id=?`, id).Scan(&count, &size, &stamp); err != nil {
+			return "", err
+		}
+		result += fmt.Sprintf(":%d:%d:%d", count, size, stamp)
+	}
+	return result, nil
+}
+
+// CaptureChildFinished reads source-owned native task completion for worker
+// liveness. A completed assistant message alone never establishes idle activity.
+// The bounded latest-part window may miss older tasks; missing proof stays active.
+func CaptureChildFinished(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, parent, child string) (bool, error) {
+	var finished int
+	err := db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT data FROM (
+ SELECT data,time_updated FROM part WHERE session_id=? AND length(data)<=65536 ORDER BY time_updated DESC LIMIT 64
+ ) WHERE json_valid(data) AND json_extract(data,'$.tool')='task'
+ AND json_extract(data,'$.state.metadata.sessionId')=?
+ ORDER BY time_updated DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE json_extract(data,'$.state.status')='completed'
+ AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM session WHERE id=? AND parent_id=?)`, parent, child, child, parent).Scan(&finished)
+	return finished > 0, err
+}
diff --git a/backend/internal/adapters/publication_set.go b/backend/internal/adapters/publication_set.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..697298d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/backend/internal/adapters/publication_set.go
@@ -0,0 +1,406 @@
+package adapters
+
+import (
+	"agenticlens/internal/adapters/capture"
+	"bytes"
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"io"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+)
+
+const publicationLimit = 128 << 20
+
+type priorArtifact struct {
+	Path    string `json:"path"`
+	Present bool   `json:"present"`
+	Data    []byte `json:"data"`
+}
+
+// validatePublicationObject requires exact, unique field names. JSON's normal
+// case-insensitive and last-key-wins struct decoding is too permissive here.
+func validatePublicationObject(body []byte, fields []string) error {
+	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(body))
+	token, err := decoder.Token()
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if token != json.Delim('{') {
+		return errors.New("publication metadata must be an object")
+	}
+	seen := map[string]bool{}
+	for decoder.More() {
+		token, err = decoder.Token()
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		key, ok := token.(string)
+		if !ok {
+			return errors.New("invalid publication metadata key")
+		}
+		allowed := false
+		for _, field := range fields {
+			if field == key {
+				allowed = true
+			}
+		}
+		if !allowed || seen[key] {
+			return fmt.Errorf("unknown or duplicate publication metadata field %q", key)
+		}
+		seen[key] = true
+		var value json.RawMessage
+		if err := decoder.Decode(&value); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	if _, err := decoder.Token(); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if len(seen) != len(fields) {
+		return errors.New("incomplete publication metadata")
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// UnmarshalJSON rejects omitted presence/data fields rather than interpreting
+// malformed metadata as authority to remove an artifact.
+func (a *priorArtifact) UnmarshalJSON(body []byte) error {
+	if err := validatePublicationObject(body, []string{"path", "present", "data"}); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	type artifactWire struct {
+		Path    string          `json:"path"`
+		Present *bool           `json:"present"`
+		Data    json.RawMessage `json:"data"`
+	}
+	var wire artifactWire
+	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(body))
+	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
+	if err := decoder.Decode(&wire); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if wire.Path == "" || wire.Present == nil || len(wire.Data) == 0 {
+		return errors.New("incomplete publication artifact metadata")
+	}
+	var data []byte
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(wire.Data, &data); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	*a = priorArtifact{Path: wire.Path, Present: *wire.Present, Data: data}
+	return nil
+}
+
+type publicationJournal struct {
+	Version     int             `json:"version"`
+	Ledger      string          `json:"ledger"`
+	MemberCount int             `json:"member_count"`
+	Artifacts   []priorArtifact `json:"artifacts"`
+}
+
+func (j *publicationJournal) UnmarshalJSON(body []byte) error {
+	if err := validatePublicationObject(body, []string{"version", "ledger", "member_count", "artifacts"}); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	type journalWire publicationJournal
+	var wire journalWire
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &wire); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	*j = publicationJournal(wire)
+	return nil
+}
+
+// canonicalPublicationPath resolves existing ancestors and dangling symlink
+// targets even before the first artifact or its parent directory exists.
+func canonicalPublicationPath(path string) (string, error) {
+	return capture.ProjectDirectory(path)
+}
+
+// publicationDestinations derives authority only from caller supplied paths.
+// Project/scope validation belongs to the caller; this boundary requires the
+// ledger itself, distinct physical members and a complete bounded set.
+func publicationDestinations(ledger string, paths []string) (string, []string, error) {
+	binding, err := canonicalPublicationPath(ledger)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", nil, err
+	}
+	targets := []string{}
+	infos := []os.FileInfo{}
+	hasLedger := false
+	for _, path := range paths {
+		if path == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		target, e := canonicalPublicationPath(path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return "", nil, e
+		}
+		info, e := os.Stat(target)
+		if e != nil && !errors.Is(e, os.ErrNotExist) {
+			return "", nil, e
+		}
+		if info != nil && !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
+			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("publication destination is not a regular file: %s", target)
+		}
+		for i, prior := range targets {
+			if target == prior || (info != nil && infos[i] != nil && os.SameFile(info, infos[i])) ||
+				strings.HasPrefix(target, prior+string(filepath.Separator)) || strings.HasPrefix(prior, target+string(filepath.Separator)) {
+				return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact destinations overlap: %s", target)
+			}
+		}
+		if target == binding {
+			hasLedger = true
+		}
+		targets = append(targets, target)
+		infos = append(infos, info)
+	}
+	if !hasLedger || len(targets) == 0 || len(targets) > 3 {
+		return "", nil, errors.New("publication requires ledger and one to three distinct authorized members")
+	}
+	marker := binding + ".publication-pending"
+	markerInfo, e := os.Stat(marker)
+	if e != nil && !errors.Is(e, os.ErrNotExist) {
+		return "", nil, e
+	}
+	for i, target := range targets {
+		if target == marker || strings.HasPrefix(marker, target+string(filepath.Separator)) ||
+			(markerInfo != nil && infos[i] != nil && os.SameFile(markerInfo, infos[i])) {
+			return "", nil, errors.New("artifact overlaps publication journal")
+		}
+	}
+	return binding, targets, nil
+}
+
+func journalPath(ledger string) string {
+	if real, err := canonicalPublicationPath(ledger); err == nil {
+		ledger = real
+	}
+	return ledger + ".publication-pending"
+}
+
+// CheckPublication makes interrupted sets visibly unavailable to readers. The
+// generator recovers under its per-output lock before reading the baseline.
+func CheckPublication(ledger string) error {
+	if _, err := os.Lstat(journalPath(ledger)); err == nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("recoverable interrupted artifact publication at %s; rerun generate to restore prior accepted set", ledger)
+	} else if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
+		return err
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func syncDirectory(path string) error {
+	f, err := os.Open(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	return errors.Join(f.Sync(), f.Close())
+}
+func durableReplace(path string, data []byte) error {
+	f, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".publication-stage-")
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	name := f.Name()
+	defer func() {
+		if e := os.Remove(name); e != nil && !errors.Is(e, os.ErrNotExist) {
+			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "publication staging cleanup:", e)
+		}
+	}()
+	_, err = f.Write(data)
+	if e := errors.Join(err, f.Sync(), f.Close()); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if err = os.Rename(name, path); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	return syncDirectory(filepath.Dir(path))
+}
+
+// BeginPublication persists a bounded prior-good set before any visible writes.
+// This is a recoverable transaction, not portable atomic multi-file rename.
+// Caller must hold the canonical ledger publication lock through commit/recovery.
+func BeginPublication(ledger string, paths []string) error {
+	if err := CheckPublication(ledger); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	binding, targets, err := publicationDestinations(ledger, paths)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	j := publicationJournal{Version: 1, Ledger: binding, MemberCount: len(targets)}
+	total := 0
+	for _, target := range targets {
+		a := priorArtifact{Path: target}
+		f, err := os.Open(target)
+		if err == nil {
+			a.Present = true
+			a.Data, err = io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(f, int64(publicationLimit-total+1)))
+			err = errors.Join(err, f.Close())
+		} else if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
+			err = nil
+		}
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		total += len(a.Data)
+		if total > publicationLimit {
+			return errors.New("publication prior-good set exceeds 128 MiB recovery bound")
+		}
+		j.Artifacts = append(j.Artifacts, a)
+	}
+	body, err := json.Marshal(j)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	return durableReplace(journalPath(ledger), body)
+}
+
+// RecoverPublication rolls back every member; the journal remains until all
+// restoration writes are durable, so a second crash repeats recovery safely.
+// authorizedPaths must come from trusted invocation/configuration after project
+// validation, never from the journal. Missing/legacy authorization fails closed.
+// Caller must hold the canonical ledger publication lock throughout recovery.
+func RecoverPublication(ledger string, authorizedPaths []string) (bool, error) {
+	marker := journalPath(ledger)
+	info, err := os.Lstat(marker)
+	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
+		return false, nil
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return false, err
+	}
+	if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
+		return true, errors.New("invalid publication journal file; explicit repair required")
+	}
+	f, err := os.Open(marker)
+	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
+		return false, nil
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return false, err
+	}
+	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(f, 2*publicationLimit+1))
+	if e := errors.Join(err, f.Close()); e != nil {
+		return true, e
+	}
+	if len(body) > 2*publicationLimit {
+		return true, errors.New("publication recovery journal exceeds bound")
+	}
+	// Validate every member before any restoration or deletion. The journal is
+	// untrusted input, including when permissions happen to be 0600.
+	binding, allowed, err := publicationDestinations(ledger, authorizedPaths)
+	if err != nil {
+		return true, fmt.Errorf("publication recovery authorization; explicit repair required: %w", err)
+	}
+	var j publicationJournal
+	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(body))
+	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
+	if err = decoder.Decode(&j); err != nil {
+		return true, fmt.Errorf("invalid publication journal; explicit repair required: %w", err)
+	}
+	if _, err = decoder.Token(); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
+		return true, errors.New("invalid trailing publication journal data; explicit repair required")
+	}
+	if j.Version != 1 || j.Ledger != binding || j.MemberCount != len(allowed) || len(j.Artifacts) != len(allowed) {
+		return true, errors.New("invalid publication version, ledger binding or complete member count; explicit repair required")
+	}
+	seen := map[string]bool{}
+	total := 0
+	for _, a := range j.Artifacts {
+		target, e := canonicalPublicationPath(a.Path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return true, fmt.Errorf("invalid publication destination; explicit repair required: %w", e)
+		}
+		authorized := false
+		for _, path := range allowed {
+			if path == target {
+				authorized = true
+			}
+		}
+		if !filepath.IsAbs(a.Path) || a.Path != target || !authorized || seen[target] {
+			return true, errors.New("unauthorized, relocated or duplicate publication destination; explicit repair required")
+		}
+		seen[target] = true
+		total += len(a.Data)
+		if total > publicationLimit || (!a.Present && len(a.Data) != 0) {
+			return true, errors.New("invalid publication prior-good data; explicit repair required")
+		}
+	}
+	for _, a := range j.Artifacts {
+		if a.Present {
+			err = durableReplace(a.Path, a.Data)
+		} else {
+			err = os.Remove(a.Path)
+			if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
+				err = nil
+			}
+			if err == nil {
+				if _, e := os.Stat(filepath.Dir(a.Path)); !errors.Is(e, os.ErrNotExist) {
+					err = syncDirectory(filepath.Dir(a.Path))
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if err != nil {
+			return true, fmt.Errorf("restoring prior-good artifact %s: %w", a.Path, err)
+		}
+	}
+	return true, CommitPublication(ledger, nil)
+}
+
+// CommitPublication removes the marker only after all new files and their
+// directories are synced. Failure retains the prior-good journal for recovery.
+func CommitPublication(ledger string, paths []string) error {
+	for _, path := range paths {
+		if path == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		f, err := os.Open(path)
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err = errors.Join(f.Sync(), f.Close()); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err = syncDirectory(filepath.Dir(path)); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	if err := os.Remove(journalPath(ledger)); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	return syncDirectory(filepath.Dir(journalPath(ledger)))
+}
+
+func readPublishedLedger(path string) ([]byte, error) {
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
+	defer cancel()
+	lock, err := capture.AcquirePublication(ctx, path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	defer func() {
+		if e := lock.Close(); e != nil {
+			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "publication read unlock:", e)
+		}
+	}()
+	return readOwnedLedger(path)
+}
+func readOwnedLedger(path string) ([]byte, error) {
+	if err := CheckPublication(path); err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	body, err := os.ReadFile(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	if err = CheckPublication(path); err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	return body, nil
+}

+package domain
+
+import "errors"
+
+// CaptureConfig configures bounded native publication. Durations use milliseconds.
+type CaptureConfig struct {
+	Enabled        bool   `yaml:"enabled" json:"enabled"`
+	StateDir       string `yaml:"state_dir" json:"state_dir"`
+	RefreshMS      int    `yaml:"refresh_ms" json:"refresh_ms"`
+	DebounceMS     int    `yaml:"debounce_ms" json:"debounce_ms"`
+	IdleMS         int    `yaml:"idle_ms" json:"idle_ms"`
+	MaxLifetimeMS  int    `yaml:"max_lifetime_ms" json:"max_lifetime_ms"`
+	PassTimeoutMS  int    `yaml:"pass_timeout_ms" json:"pass_timeout_ms"`
+	MaxSessions    int    `yaml:"max_sessions" json:"max_sessions"`
+	MaxSourceBytes int64  `yaml:"max_source_bytes" json:"max_source_bytes"`
+	DetailedReport bool   `yaml:"detailed_report" json:"detailed_report"`
+	Summary        bool   `yaml:"summary" json:"summary"`
+}
+
+func DefaultCaptureConfig() CaptureConfig {
+	return CaptureConfig{Enabled: true, StateDir: ".agenticlens-capture", RefreshMS: 15000, DebounceMS: 500, IdleMS: 120000, MaxLifetimeMS: 1800000, PassTimeoutMS: 30000, MaxSessions: 256, MaxSourceBytes: 64 * 1024 * 1024, DetailedReport: true, Summary: true}
+}
+
+// Validate rejects unbounded or contradictory native worker settings.
+func (cfg CaptureConfig) Validate() error {
+	if cfg.StateDir == "" || cfg.RefreshMS < 100 || cfg.DebounceMS < 0 || cfg.DebounceMS > cfg.RefreshMS || cfg.IdleMS < cfg.RefreshMS || cfg.MaxLifetimeMS < cfg.IdleMS || cfg.MaxLifetimeMS > 86400000 || cfg.PassTimeoutMS < 100 || cfg.PassTimeoutMS > 300000 || cfg.MaxSessions < 1 || cfg.MaxSourceBytes < 1 {
+		return errors.New("invalid telemetry.capture settings: positive bounded cadence, work and state path required")
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+package domain
+
+import "fmt"
+
+// CaptureTicketMetadata rejects conflicting explicit context independently of row
+// order. Rebinding the conflicting registrations explicitly resolves a conflict.
+func CaptureTicketMetadata(rows []CaptureRegistration, ticket string) (string, string, error) {
+	titles := map[string]bool{}
+	kinds := map[string]bool{}
+	var title, kind string
+	for _, r := range rows {
+		if r.TicketID != ticket {
+			continue
+		}
+		if r.TicketTitle != "" {
+			titles[r.TicketTitle] = true
+			title = r.TicketTitle
+		}
+		if r.TicketType != "" {
+			kinds[r.TicketType] = true
+			kind = r.TicketType
+		}
+	}
+	if len(titles) > 1 {
+		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("ticket %s has conflicting explicit titles; rebind conflicting registrations with one explicit title", ticket)
+	}
+	if len(kinds) > 1 {
+		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("ticket %s has conflicting explicit types; rebind conflicting registrations with one explicit type", ticket)
+	}
+	return title, kind, nil
+}

+func startCorrectionWorker(t *testing.T, f captureGenerationFixture) {
+	t.Helper()
+	s, err := capture.OpenProject(f.state, f.project)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err = s.RequestPublication(context.Background()); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	s.Close()
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 8*time.Second)
+	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, cliBinaryPath, "capture", "worker", "--repo", f.project, "--state-dir", f.state)
+	cmd.Dir = f.project
+	log, err := os.CreateTemp(t.TempDir(), "worker")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	cmd.Stdout = log
+	cmd.Stderr = log
+	if err = cmd.Start(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	done := make(chan error, 1)
+	go func() { done <- cmd.Wait() }()
+	t.Cleanup(func() {
+		writeCapturePolicy(t, f, false, 0)
+		select {
+		case err := <-done:
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Errorf("worker: %v %s", err, readCaptureFile(t, log.Name()))
+			}
+		case <-time.After(4 * time.Second):
+			cancel()
+			<-done
+			t.Error("worker did not stop after disabling")
+		}
+		cancel()
+		log.Close()
+		deadline := time.Now().Add(3 * time.Second)
+		for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
+			lock, err := capture.AcquireWorker(f.state)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Error(err)
+				return
+			}
+			if lock != nil {
+				lock.Close()
+				return
+			}
+			time.Sleep(20 * time.Millisecond)
+		}
+		t.Error("automatic worker chain retained ownership after disable")
+	})
+}
+func waitCorrectionLedger(t *testing.T, path, id string, tokens int64) {
